world: Brinemouth is a stilt-town of rope, tar and lamplight, built on the roofs of a city of glass that drowned three hundred years ago. Divers go down for salvage: lamps, glasswork, guild seals. The city's songs still sound in the deep water, and some of its guardians still keep their posts.

sections.title: The Drowned City
sections.text: Streets of green glass, cathedrals with walls you can see through, bells that ring when the tide turns. Most of it is still there, under forty fathoms of cold water.

sections.title: The Lamp Guilds
sections.text: The guilds that lit the old city still exist in Brinemouth, poor and proud. Their marks are on every lamp in the deep.

sections.title: The Dock
sections.text: Lamp Dock is where crews are hired, paid and cheated. Auntie Pell runs it.
